identityInventory.source: Read-only production PostgreSQL aggregate; no user identifiers retained.

RV-01.title: Successful strict provider reverification retries the original action
evidence: A protected Operations task mutation returned HTTP 403 before reverification and HTTP 200 after the provider flow.
The completed task persisted a server timestamp and an authenticated completer.
The matching audit row records the same authenticated actor and the exact pre-completion and completed states.

RV-02.title: Cancelled provider reverification creates no partial mutation
evidence: The published Clerk prompt was cancelled without retrying the protected task mutation.
The selected production task remained OPEN with no completion timestamp or completer.
The selected task had no Operations task audit rows after cancellation.

redaction: No passwords, OTPs, session tokens, JWTs, Clerk secrets, user identifiers, household identifiers, or task identifiers are retained.
